facts.value: International students must obtain an F-1 or J-1 visa.
Students must first receive a SEVIS number and I-20 document from ASU.
Your ASURITE User ID is the official login name you’ll use to access most ASU systems and services.
You’ll log in to My ASU with your ASURITE User ID and password.
After you enroll in classes, visit asu.edu/emailsignup to activate your official @asu.edu email address.
All first-year students are required to take the math placement test.
The test must be taken at least seven calendar days before their Academic Orientation Session.
Students can share their academic records with parents or guardians through My ASU Parent Guest Access.
Pay your enrollment deposit through My ASU to confirm you will attend.
For fall 2026 admits, the enrollment deposit will be available beginning Oct. 1, 2025.
